title: What is PixelLearn?
content: PixelLearn is a practice-first coding education platform. Learners explore structured courses, complete interactive exercises, use a browser playground, track XP and streaks, and access career-oriented AI tools.

title: PixelLearn features
content: Core PixelLearn features are courses with chapters and exercises, an interactive Monaco-based code playground, code execution, XP and streak tracking, achievements, a dashboard, a leaderboard, pricing plans, and AI career tools.

title: Using the playground
content: Open a course exercise to use the PixelLearn playground. The workspace includes a code editor, theory and problem context, output or preview panels, and code assistance such as conversion and flowchart generation. Exercise completions update learner progress.

title: Finding courses
content: Browse courses from the Courses page. Courses are organized into chapters and ordered exercises with language, difficulty, theory, problem statements, hints, starter code, and XP rewards.

title: Data structures learning guide
content: For data structures and algorithms, build foundations in arrays and complexity first. Progress through stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, graphs, and dynamic programming while solving exercises and reviewing complexity trade-offs.
